description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractNamespaceCommandResponse' which implements common behavior for namespace command responses in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains fields for namespace and resourceType, methods for accessing these fields, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString. It also includes payload serialization logic.

classes.name: AbstractNamespaceCommandResponse
classes.description: An abstract base class that provides common functionality for namespace command responses, including handling of namespace and resource type fields, equality, and payload serialization.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace associated with this response.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the namespace as the identifier of this response.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns an EntityId object representing the namespace.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with this response.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer resource path, defaulting to an empty pointer.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality based on namespace, resource type, and superclass equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on superclass hash, namespace, and resource type.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response payload into a JSON object builder, including namespace and resource type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object including namespace and resource type.
